name: SuperTuxKart
title: SuperTuxKart: free Mario Kart alternative
caption:
Mario Kart World costs $79.99. SuperTuxKart lets you race karts with friends for free 🏁

✅ 21 tracks and 18 karts, with power-ups all over the road
✅ Race, battle or play soccer with up to 8 friends on one computer
✅ Story mode, Grand Prix cups and Time Trial
✅ No ads, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · Android
ℹ️ It's not Mario Kart: no Nintendo characters, its own mascots and tracks. Mobile is a separate download. Mario Kart World's $79.99 is Nintendo's Switch 2 price

Comment "KART" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

dm_pitch: SuperTuxKart, the free open-source kart racing game 🏁

beats.say: Strangers on the internet built their own kart racer, and it costs nothing.
Mario Kart World costs eighty bucks. SuperTuxKart costs nothing.
Twenty one tracks, eighteen karts, and power-ups all over the road.
Up to eight friends on one computer can race, battle, or play soccer.
It runs on Windows, Mac, Linux and Android, and there's even a story mode.
It's kart night with your friends, minus the eighty dollar game.
Comment Kart, and I'll send you the link.
